title: Life cycle assessment on methods for polyhydroxyalkanoate extraction from aerobic granules
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00335K, Paper
Rong Er Lim, Syahirah Faraheen Kabir Ahmad, Gobi Kanadasan, Vel Murugan Vadivelu
This study uniquely integrates aerobic granule cultivation and life cycle assessment to identify eco-friendly PHA extraction methods from POME, promoting sustainable bioplastic production from wastewater resources.
